description:
Dr. Peter McCullough on Sen. Ron Johnson's Roundtable on Covid-19 Vaccines, medical censorship and Twitter and the new study published in the official journal of the German Cardiac Society--finding that 3 people who died unexpectedly shortly after Covid-19 shots were likely killed by the vaccine.Show more "Medical censorship has to be stopped...it is a disturbing trend. You reviewed it well with Dr. Bhattacharya...both he and I and others have been trying to bring America the truth about the pandemic with solid analyses and we do have our right to free speech." -Dr. Peter McCullough.
